newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end volatile Tokyo with handsome gains.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end volatile Tokyo with handsome gains.

text.p: The key December Japanese Government Bond (JGB) futures contract ended a volatile session with handsome gains as late short-covering outweighed speculative selling, traders said on Friday.

The December rose to a high of 124.93 on news that Japan's Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka and Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto agreed to work on cutting government debt issues for 1997/98 by more than three trillion yen.
But a round of speculative selling, which set in at above 124.90, forced the December down to an afternoon low of 124.40.
The December closed at 124.75, up from 124.35 on Thursday.
